info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Audit Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Internal Audit Reviews Submission API facilitates the process of submitting reviews pertaining to internal audits within enterprise banking services. This endpoint allows authorized users to provide feedback and assessments on audit findings, ensuring compliance and quality assurance. Typical consumers of this API include internal audit teams and compliance officers who are responsible for evaluating and improving banking operations. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their audit processes, leading to better oversight and risk management.
